title: Condensed realization preserves the specified open counit
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of positive characteristic $p\ne\ell$, and an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Y$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-open-immersion]. For $T=U,Y$ put $R_T=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}(\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z)_T$ on its small pro-etale site, and let $\mathcal I_T$ be the completed integral constructible category with its actual normalized strict reduction tower [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete, lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Put $B_T=p_T^*\underline\Omega$, where $\underline\Omega$ is the finite-extension-valued condensed algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit]. Use $\mathcal C_T=D_{\mathrm{cons}}(T,\underline\Omega)$ and its ordinary module-object operations [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, sk-def-sfb-dc-restricted-functors]. Let $V_T:\mathcal I_T\to\mathcal C_T$ be $M\mapsto B_T\otimes^L_{E_T^c}J_T(M[1/\ell])$, with $E_T^c=p_T^*C(-,\mathbf Q_\ell)$ and the specified coefficient realization $J_T$ of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization].

Write $j_{!,R}\dashv j_R^*$ for the ordinary completed-ring open adjunction and $\epsilon_R$ for its counit. It restricts to the completed constructible categories, and is identified with the realized strict-system adjunction by the actual reduction/total-limit comparison of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. Write $j_{!,B}\dashv j_B^*$ and $\epsilon_B$ for the specified condensed open adjunction restricted to $\mathcal C$ [def-sfb-dc-open-lower-shriek-adjunction]. For $M\in\mathcal I_U$, let
$$b_M:V_Yj_{!,R}M\xrightarrow{\sim}j_{!,B}V_UM$$
be the compact-support realization comparison of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization] for the trivial compactification $(j,\mathrm{id}_Y)$ and $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$: precisely, $V_Y$ of the inverse of the identification $P_RM\cong j_{!,R}M$ given by $d_j(M)\circ\mathcal L_Y(\alpha_M)\circ u_{P_RM}$, followed by $B_Y\otimes^L_{E_Y^c}a_{j,E,M}$ and the projection comparison $T^Y_{E,\Omega}P_E^c\simeq P_\Omega^cT^U_{E,\Omega}$, with the identity direct-image factors removed. Here $\alpha_M:\mathcal R_Y(P_RM)\simeq\mathcal E_j\mathcal R_UM$ is the system comparison of that lemma for this compactification, $\mathcal E_j$ is exact termwise system extension by zero (written $J_j$ in the next citation), and $d_j$ and the reduction/total-limit unit $u$ are those of [lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison]. The canonical coefficient/restriction comparison
$$s_L:V_Uj_R^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}j_B^*V_YL$$
is induced by restricting K-flat scalar-extension representatives, with $j^{-1}R_Y=R_U$ and $j^{-1}B_Y=B_U$. Then these specified comparisons identify the actual open counits: for every $L\in\mathcal I_Y$,
$$\epsilon_{B,V_YL}\circ j_{!,B}(s_L)\circ b_{j_R^*L}=V_Y(\epsilon_{R,L}).$$
The integral counit here is the image of the strict coefficient-system counit under the actual total-limit/reduction units, rather than an arbitrarily chosen lift of its evaluations. The unit identifications $V_T(R_T)\simeq\mathbf1_T$, namely the case $d=0$ of [lem-pur-condensed-tate-realization] through $R_T\simeq R\varprojlim_n(\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z)_T$, carry $s_{R_Y}$ to the inverse of the monoidal pullback unit isomorphism $j_B^*\mathbf1_Y\simeq\mathbf1_U$ [lem-sfb-derived-pullback-strong-monoidal].

proof.text: Take the coefficient model and its normalized scalar units from the coefficient-model lemma. Retain all three normalization conclusions with these same data.

For each U,Y,j apply the fixed-model geometric open comparison to the same coefficient model and its FactorNormalized proof. Its preservation witness, two invertibility conclusions and prescribed counit equation supply exactly the remaining conjunction. The strict-system and unit-normalization conclusions retained in the first step concern these same data; no new coefficient choice is made.
